keyVerseDR: "The heavens shew forth the glory of God." (Ps 19:1)

level1.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Appreciation of Beauty
level1.story: Appreciation of beauty means noticing and enjoying beautiful things. They point us to God!
level1.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice appreciation of beauty all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What was the most beautiful thing we saw this week?
How does beauty help us think of God?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
Practice appreciation of beauty every day
level1.prayer: God of beauty, open my eyes to the wonders You made. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Look at the sky and thank God
TUE: Smell a flower or notice a tree
THU: Look closely at a church window or statue
FRI: Notice something beautiful someone did
SAT: Draw the most beautiful thing you saw

level2.title: This Week's Catholic Virtue: Appreciation of Beauty
level2.story: Appreciation of beauty means noticing and enjoying beauty and excellence everywhere: in nature, art, music, and in good people. A sunset, a song, a church window, or a kind act can fill us with wonder. The psalm says the heavens tell of the glory of God. All true beauty points us to God, who is Beauty itself.
level2.heartIntro: Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice appreciation of beauty all week. On Saturday, talk together, write what you practiced, and a parent signs.
questions: What was the most beautiful thing we saw this week?
How did God help us grow in appreciation of beauty?
actions: Hang this sheet on the fridge
Practice appreciation of beauty every day
level2.prayer: God of beauty, open my eyes to the wonders You made. Amen.

activity.title: Daily Action Checklist
activity.intro: Color a star each day, Monday through Saturday. Hang this sheet on the fridge and practice with your family. A parent signs at the end of the week.
items: MON: Take a walk and look for beauty
TUE: Look at a sacred painting together
WED: Listen to a hymn or Gregorian chant
FRI: Keep your room neat and beautiful
SAT: Watch a sunset or stars and pray
